text_en: He entered Jericho and was passing through it.
text_cn: 耶稣进了耶里哥，正经过的时候，

text_en: A man was there named Zacchaeus; he was a chief tax collector and was rich.
text_cn: 有一个人，名叫匝凯，他原是税吏长，是个富有的人。

text_en: He was trying to see who Jesus was, but on account of the crowd he could not, because he was short in stature.
text_cn: 他想要看看耶稣是什么人；但由于人多，不能看见，因为他身材短小。

text_en: So he ran ahead and climbed a sycamore tree to see him, because he was going to pass that way.
text_cn: 于是他往前奔跑，攀上了一棵野桑树，要看看耶稣，因为耶稣就要从那里经过。

text_en: When Jesus came to the place, he looked up and said to him, “Zacchaeus, hurry and come down; for I must stay at your house today. ”
text_cn: 耶稣来到那地方，抬头一看，对他说：“匝凯，你快下来！因为我今天必须住在你家中。”

text_en: So he hurried down and was happy to welcome him.
text_cn: 他便赶快下来，喜悦地款留耶稣。

text_en: All who saw it began to grumble and said, “He has gone to be the guest of one who is a sinner. ”
text_cn: 众人见了，都窃窃私议说：“他竟到有罪的人那里投宿。”

text_en: Zacchaeus stood there and said to the Lord, “Look, half of my possessions, Lord, I will give to the poor; and if I have defrauded anyone of anything, I will pay back four times as much. ”
text_cn: 匝凯站起来对主说：“主，你看，我把我财物的一半施舍给穷人；我如果欺骗过谁，我就以四倍赔偿。”

text_en: Then Jesus said to him, “Today salvation has come to this house, because he too is a son of Abraham.
text_cn: 耶稣对他说：“今天救恩临到了这一家，因为他也是亚巴郎之子。

text_en: For the Son of Man came to seek out and to save the lost. ”
text_cn: 因为人子来，是为寻找及拯救迷失了的人。”

text_en: As they were listening to this, he went on to tell a parable, because he was near Jerusalem, and because they supposed that the kingdom of God was to appear immediately.
text_cn: 众人听这话的时候，耶稣因为已临近耶路撒冷，而且他们都以为天主的国快要出现，遂设了一个比喻，

text_en: So he said, “A nobleman went to a distant country to get royal power for himself and then return.
text_cn: 说：“有一个贵人起身到远方去，为取得了王位再回来。

text_en: He summoned ten of his slaves, and gave them ten pounds, and said to them, ‘Do business with these until I come back. ’
text_cn: 他将自己的十个仆人叫来，交给他们十个‘米纳’，并嘱咐说：你们拿去做生意，直到我回来。

text_en: But the citizens of his country hated him and sent a delegation after him, saying, ‘We do not want this man to rule over us. ’
text_cn: 他本国的人，一向怀恨他，遂在他后面派代表去说：我们不愿意这人为王统治我们。

text_en: When he returned, having received royal power, he ordered these slaves, to whom he had given the money, to be summoned so that he might find out what they had gained by trading.
text_cn: 他得了王位归来以后，便传令将那些领了他钱的仆人给他召来，想知道每个人做生意赚了多少。

text_en: The first came forward and said, ‘Lord, your pound has made ten more pounds. ’
text_cn: 第一个前来说：主，你的那个‘米纳’赚了十个‘米纳’。

text_en: He said to him, ‘Well done, good slave! Because you have been trustworthy in a very small thing, take charge of ten cities. ’
text_cn: 主人给他说：好，善仆！你既然在小事上忠信，你要有权掌管十座城。

text_en: Then the second came, saying, ‘Lord, your pound has made five pounds. ’
text_cn: 第二个前来说：主，你的那个‘米纳’赚了五个‘米纳’。

text_en: He said to him, ‘And you, rule over five cities. ’
text_cn: 主人也给这人说：你也要掌管五座城。

text_en: Then the other came, saying, ‘Lord, here is your pound. I wrapped it up in a piece of cloth,
text_cn: 另一个前来说：主，看，你那个‘米纳’，我收存在手巾里。

text_en: for I was afraid of you, because you are a harsh man; you take what you did not deposit, and reap what you did not sow. ’
text_cn: 我一向害怕你，因为你是一个严厉的人：你没有存放的，也要提取；没有下种的，也要收割。

text_en: He said to him, ‘I will judge you by your own words, you wicked slave! You knew, did you, that I was a harsh man, taking what I did not deposit and reaping what I did not sow?
text_cn: 主人向他说：恶仆！我就凭你的口供定你的罪。你不是知道我是个严厉的人，没有存放的，也要提取；没有下种的，也要收割的吗？

text_en: Why then did you not put my money into the bank? Then when I returned, I could have collected it with interest. ’
text_cn: 为什么你不把我的钱存于钱庄？迨(dài)我回来时，我可以连本带利取出来。

text_en: He said to the bystanders, ‘Take the pound from him and give it to the one who has ten pounds. ’
text_cn: 主人便向侍立左右的人说：你们把他那个‘米纳’夺过来，给那有十个的。

text_en: (And they said to him, ‘Lord, he has ten pounds! ’)
text_cn: 他们向他说：主，他已有十个‘米纳’了。

text_en: ‘I tell you, to all those who have, more will be given; but from those who have nothing, even what they have will be taken away.
text_cn: 我告诉你们：凡是有的，还要给他；那没有的，连他所有的，也要从他夺去。

text_en: But as for these enemies of mine who did not want me to be king over them—bring them here and slaughter them in my presence. ’”
text_cn: 至于那些敌对我，不愿意我作他们君王的人，你们把他们押到这里，在我面前杀掉。”

text_en: After he had said this, he went on ahead, going up to Jerusalem.
text_cn: 耶稣说了这些话，就领头前行，上耶路撒冷去了。

text_en: When he had come near Bethphage and Bethany, at the place called the Mount of Olives, he sent two of the disciples,
text_cn: 及至临近贝特法革和伯达尼，在一座名叫橄榄山那里，耶稣派遣两个门徒说：

text_en: saying, “Go into the village ahead of you, and as you enter it you will find tied there a colt that has never been ridden. Untie it and bring it here.
text_cn: “你们往对面的村庄里去，一进村，就会看见一匹拴着的驴驹，从来没有人骑过，把它解开，牵来。

text_en: If anyone asks you, ‘Why are you untying it? ’ just say this, ‘The Lord needs it. ’”
text_cn: 如果有人问你们说：你们为什么解它？你们要这样说：主要用它。”

text_en: So those who were sent departed and found it as he had told them.
text_cn: 被派的人去了，所遇见的，正如对他们说过的一样。

text_en: As they were untying the colt, its owners asked them, “Why are you untying the colt? ”
text_cn: 他们正在解驴驹的时候，驴驹的主人对他们说：“你们为什么解这驴驹？”

text_en: They said, “The Lord needs it. ”
text_cn: 他们说：“主要用它。”

text_en: Then they brought it to Jesus; and after throwing their cloaks on the colt, they set Jesus on it.
text_cn: 他们遂把驴驹牵到耶稣跟前，把他们的外衣搭在驴驹上，扶耶稣骑上。

text_en: As he rode along, people kept spreading their cloaks on the road.
text_cn: 前行的时候，人们把自己的外衣铺在路上。

text_en: As he was now approaching the path down from the Mount of Olives, the whole multitude of the disciples began to praise God joyfully with a loud voice for all the deeds of power that they had seen,
text_cn: 当他临近橄榄山的下坡时，众门徒为了所见过的一切奇能，都欢欣的大声颂扬天主说：

text_en: saying, “Blessed is the king who comes in the name of the Lord! Peace in heaven, and glory in the highest heaven! ”
text_cn: “因上主之名而来的君王，应受赞颂！和平在天上，光荣于高天！”

text_en: Some of the Pharisees in the crowd said to him, “Teacher, order your disciples to stop. ”
text_cn: 人群中有几个法利塞人对耶稣说：“师傅，责斥你的门徒罢！”

text_en: He answered, “I tell you, if these were silent, the stones would shout out. ”
text_cn: 耶稣回答说：“我告诉你们：这些人若不作声，石头就要喊叫了！”

text_en: As he came near and saw the city, he wept over it,
text_cn: 耶稣临近的时候，望见京城，便哀哭她说：

text_en: saying, “If you, even you, had only recognized on this day the things that make for peace! But now they are hidden from your eyes.
text_cn: “恨不能在这一天，你也知道有关你平安的事；但这事如今在你眼前是隐藏的。

text_en: Indeed, the days will come upon you, when your enemies will set up ramparts around you and surround you, and hem you in on every side.
text_cn: 的确，日子将临于你，你的仇敌要在你四周筑起壁垒，包围你，四面窘困你；

text_en: They will crush you to the ground, you and your children within you, and they will not leave within you one stone upon another; because you did not recognize the time of your visitation from God. ”
text_cn: 又要荡平你，及在你内的子民；在你内决不留一块石头在另一块石头上，因为你没有认识眷顾你的时期。”

text_en: Then he entered the temple and began to drive out those who were selling things there;
text_cn: 耶稣进了殿院，开始把买卖人赶出去。

text_en: and he said, “It is written, ‘My house shall be a house of prayer’; but you have made it a den of robbers. ”
text_cn: 对他们说：“经上记载：我的殿宇应是祈祷之所，而你们竟把它做了贼窝。”

text_en: Every day he was teaching in the temple. The chief priests, the scribes, and the leaders of the people kept looking for a way to kill him;
text_cn: 耶稣每天在圣殿内施教。司祭长及经师并人民的首领，设法要除掉他；

text_en: but they did not find anything they could do, for all the people were spellbound by what they heard.
text_cn: 但是寻不出什么办法，因为众百姓都倾心听他。
